exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) vs. repeat cesarean delivery (RCD)
cohort: A national sample of women with singleton pregnancies who underwent either TOLAC or RCD from 2006 to 2012
finding: TOLAC is associated with modest reductions in maternal hospitalization costs compared to RCD, but other factors like hospital region, demographics, and comorbidities are stronger predictors of cost.
mod_finding: This study found that trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) was associated with modest cost reductions for maternal hospitalizations compared to repeat cesarean delivery (RCD).
